ready_additions.evidence_contract_sha256: SHA256 of this immutable contract file

evidence_required_fields.flash_attention_nodes: array of observed FA node records, one unique name per full-attention layer
evidence_required_fields.classifier_nodes: array with exactly one weighted node record for cls.output.weight
evidence_required_fields.token_embedding_nodes: array with exactly one weighted node record for token_embd.weight GET_ROWS
evidence_required_fields.vocabulary_matmul_nodes: empty array; any observed token_embd.weight MUL_MAT is a failure

device_record_fields.backend: actual ggml backend registry name, e.g. CUDA or CPU
device_record_fields.type: actual device type mapped to CPU, GPU, IGPU, ACCEL, or UNKNOWN
device_record_fields.name: actual device name

weighted_node_record_fields.name: nonempty tensor node name
weighted_node_record_fields.op: MUL_MAT for classifier or vocabulary; GET_ROWS for token embedding

cuda_admission.flash_attention_output_devices: every node backend CUDA and type GPU or IGPU
cuda_admission.classifier_output_and_weight_devices: both backend CUDA and type GPU or IGPU
cuda_admission.token_embedding_weight_device: backend CPU and type CPU; lookup output may be CPU or CUDA

cpu_tests: All observed devices must be honestly reported; FA and classifier output/weight must be CPU, token embedding weight CPU. CPU pass is not CUDA proof.
observation: Only successful post-execution scheduler observations count, not request flags or pre-execution callbacks. Callback never throws across C boundary; missing/invalid evidence rejects the request.
unchanged: Original GGUF bytes, original source and llama.cpp pins, rawF32 scoring, noncausal whole prompt, one physical batch, F16 KV cache, frozen28-case numerical thresholds.
not_proven_by_attestation: No additional unused model-weight allocation: require actual model buffer/peak measurements.
